open_banking_api_auth_bypass.description: Open Banking / PSD2 API authorization bypass. Third-party providers (TPP) access bank accounts via APIs (UK Open Banking, EU PSD2, US FDX). Test: can a TPP token access accounts beyond its consent scope? Can expired consent still fetch data? Does the bank enforce SCA (Strong Customer Authentication) on every sensitive operation?

probes.description: Consent scope test — fetch a resource outside the granted consent scope (e.g., consent for account A, request account B)
Expired consent replay — replay a request with an expired consent token

wire_transfer_amount_tampering.description: Wire/ACH transfer amount and recipient tampering. The client sends amount, currency, and recipient in the request body. Test: can the amount be changed after the confirmation screen? Can a negative amount trigger a reverse transfer? Does currency switching (USD→VND) bypass amount limits? Is the beneficiary ID validated server-side or just displayed from the request?

probes.description: Negative transfer amount — may trigger a reverse credit to the sender
Sub-cent amount — tests rounding behavior and minimum transfer validation
Overflow amount — exceeds typical balance, tests server-side limit check

transaction_replay_idempotency.description: Transaction replay / missing idempotency. Replay the exact same payment request — if processed twice, the system lacks idempotency controls. Financial systems must reject duplicate transaction IDs. Test: replay with same idempotency key (should be rejected), replay without key (should be rejected by dedup), replay with modified amount but same reference (should be rejected).

probes.description: Exact replay — send the same request twice. A 200 on the second means no dedup.

kyc_aml_bypass.description: KYC/AML verification bypass. Test: can a user perform high-value transactions without completing KYC? Can document verification status be changed via API (mass_assignment on verified=true)? Does the system enforce transaction limits for unverified accounts? Can a blocked/frozen account still initiate transfers via API?

probes.description: Mass assignment on KYC status — attempt to set verified=true via profile update

payment_page_script_injection.description: PCI DSS 4.0 Req 6.4.3: payment page script integrity. Third-party scripts on payment pages can skim card data (Magecart). Test: are unknown scripts loaded? Do scripts have SRI (Subresource Integrity) hashes? Is there a CSP that restricts script sources? Can an XSS or DOM clobbering inject a script on the payment page?

probes.description: Enumerate scripts on payment page — check for third-party domains, missing SRI, inline scripts

card_number_exposure.description: PCI DSS card data exposure in responses. Full PAN (Primary Account Number) must never appear in API responses, logs, or error messages. Test: does any endpoint return full card numbers? Does an error message leak card data? Are card numbers masked (show only last 4)?

probes.description: Detect unmasked PAN in response body — Luhn-valid 13-19 digit sequences

mfa_sca_downgrade.description: MFA/SCA downgrade attack for financial transactions. PSD2 requires SCA (two of: knowledge, possession, inherence) for electronic payments. Test: can a transaction proceed with only one factor? Can the second factor be skipped by modifying the request? Does the fallback (SMS OTP) have weaker security than the primary (FIDO2)?

probes.description: Remove or empty the second factor parameter and replay the transaction

loan_parameter_manipulation.description: Loan/credit parameter manipulation. Test: can interest rate, term length, or credit limit be modified in the request? Can a loan application bypass credit scoring by tampering with submitted data? Does pre-approval flow trust client-side calculated values?

probes.description: Zero interest rate — if accepted, the server trusts client-side rate calculation
